name: Scenario U: Testimonial Request — 30-Day Post-Onboarding
comments:
SCENARIO U — TESTIMONIAL REQUEST

PURPOSE: When a HubSpot deal's 'client_onboarding_date' property is set (via a HubSpot Workflow that fires a webhook), wait 30 days (2592000 seconds), then verify the client is still active (HubSpot GET contact by email), generate a personalized testimonial request email via OpenRouter (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 with fallback to env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL), and send it via Resend HTTP POST. The email asks the client for both a Google review AND a short written testimonial for the website.

WHITE-LABEL NOTE: The client-facing email MUST send from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS. Never use brian@cwiai.net as a client-facing sender. Internal alerts use env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.

OPENROUTER FALLBACK: The OpenRouter request body includes a 'models' array [anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL] so OpenRouter automatically falls back to the secondary model if the primary is unavailable.

FLOW OVERVIEW:
  Module 1 (gateway:CustomWebHook hook 3020) — HubSpot webhook: deal property 'client_onboarding_date' set
  Module 2 (builtin:Sleep 2592000 s)          — Wait 30 days (2592000 seconds)
  Module 3 (http:ActionSendData)              — HubSpot GET contact by email to confirm client is still active
  Module 4 (builtin:BasicFeeder / filter)     — Guard: only proceed if hs_lead_status = 'Client Active'
  Module 5 (http:ActionSendData)              — OpenRouter POST — Claude generates personalized testimonial request email body
  Module 6 (http:ActionSendData)              — Resend POST — sends testimonial request to client
  Module 7 (http:ActionSendData)              — HubSpot POST — logs 'Testimonial request sent' note on contact
  Module 8 (http:ActionSendData)              — Resend POST — internal alert to env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS confirming send
  Error Handler (http:ActionSendData)         — Resend alert to env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS on any failure

SECRETS (all via env.VARIABLE_NAME — never hardcoded):
  env.HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN    — HubSpot Private App token
  env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY           — OpenRouter API key
  env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL    — Fallback model slug for OpenRouter (e.g. openai/gpt-4o)
  env.RESEND_API_KEY               — Resend API key
  env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS          — Verified client-facing sender (never brian@cwiai.net)
  env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS       — Internal CWI alert sender for internal alerts and error emails
  env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK           — Full Google Business review URL
  env.CLIENT_NAME                  — White-labeled business display name used in the AI prompt

TIMEZONE: America/New_York

TESTING: POST a test webhook payload with { dealId, contactEmail, contactFirstName, contactLastName, onboardingDate } to hook 3020. Confirm the 30-day sleep fires, the HubSpot contact check passes, OpenRouter returns a valid email body, Resend delivers from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS, and the HubSpot note appears on the contact.

metadata.label: HubSpot Webhook: deal.propertyChange -> client_onboarding_date
metadata.note: Module 1: Instant webhook trigger on hook ID 3020. Configure a HubSpot deal-based Workflow that enrolls when the property 'client_onboarding_date' is known / is set, and adds a 'Send a webhook' action (POST) to the Make.com webhook URL. Expected payload: { dealId, contactEmail, contactFirstName, contactLastName, onboardingDate }. Key downstream fields: 1.body.contactEmail, 1.body.contactFirstName, 1.body.contactLastName, 1.body.dealId, 1.body.onboardingDate.

Module 2: Sleep 2592000 seconds (30 days exactly: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 = 2592000). Pauses the scenario run so the testimonial request fires 30 days after the onboarding date is set — enough time for the client to experience real results. Make.com Enterprise plans support long-running scenario pauses; confirm your plan supports waits exceeding 24 hours before enabling.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.note: Module 3: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/search. Searches for the HubSpot contact by email (1.body.contactEmail). Returns contact id, email, firstname, lastname, hs_lead_status, and lifecyclestage. The guard filter in module 4 reads 3.body.results[0].properties.hs_lead_status to confirm the client is still active before sending any email. If the contact is not found (empty results), the filter blocks execution and the error handler fires.

Module 4: Guard filter. Only proceeds when hs_lead_status == 'Client Active' on the contact returned from module 3. Prevents sending a testimonial request to churned, paused, or inactive clients. If the contact has left or their status changed in the 30-day window, execution halts here silently (no error — the error handler is not triggered for a legitimate skip).

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.note: Module 5: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions. Uses the 'models' array [anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL] for automatic OpenRouter fallback if the primary model is unavailable. System prompt instructs Claude to write warm, professional email copy with no CWI branding. User prompt requests a 3-paragraph body: (1) acknowledge the 30-day milestone, (2) request a Google review AND a written testimonial via reply, (3) warm close. max_tokens: 500, temperature: 0.7. Claude response is at 5.body.choices[0].message.content.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.note: Module 6: POST https://api.resend.com/emails. FROM env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (verified client-facing sender — never brian@cwiai.net). TO 1.body.contactEmail. SUBJECT 'Your 30-day milestone — could we ask a quick favour?'. HTML body: greeting with contactFirstName, Claude-generated 3-paragraph body (5.body.choices[0].message.content), a Google Review CTA button (env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK), and a written testimonial reply-to-email CTA. Plain-text fallback also appends env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK. env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS must be a verified Resend sender domain.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.note: Module 7: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/notes. Creates a HubSpot note associated to the contact (3.body.results[0].id) via associationTypeId 202 (Note-to-Contact, HUBSPOT_DEFINED). Note body records: send date/time ET, contact name and email, deal ID, from address, Google review link, and that both Google review and written testimonial were requested. hs_timestamp uses Unix milliseconds via formatDate(now; 'x'). env.HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN must have crm.objects.notes.write scope.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.note: Module 8: Resend HTTP POST — internal success alert. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. TO env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS (self-alert to internal inbox). Subject includes client name and email. HTML body contains a styled confirmation table: client name, email, deal ID, onboarding date, sending from address, Google review link, sent-at timestamp (ET), and HubSpot contact ID. Prompts follow-up if no response within 7 business days.

errorHandlers.label: Error Handler — Testimonial Request Failed (Resend alert)

metadata.note: Error Handler (module 9): Catches any failure in modules 3–8 (HubSpot contact check, OpenRouter call, Resend send, HubSpot note, internal alert). Sends a Resend alert FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS TO env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS with client details (name, email, deal ID, onboarding date), error message, failed module, scenario run ID, and ET timestamp. handleErrors: false prevents recursive error loops. Manual follow-up is required when this fires.

notes.content: Module 1: Instant webhook trigger (hook 3020). HubSpot deal-based Workflow fires when client_onboarding_date is set. Payload: { dealId, contactEmail, contactFirstName, contactLastName, onboardingDate }.
Module 2: builtin:Sleep 2592000 seconds (30 days). Delays execution so the testimonial request fires after the client has had meaningful time to experience results.
Module 3: HubSpot CRM contact search by email (1.body.contactEmail). Returns contact id, hs_lead_status, lifecyclestage. Used by module 4 guard filter.
Module 4: Guard filter — hs_lead_status == 'Client Active'. Stops execution for churned or inactive clients without triggering the error handler.

Module 5: OpenRouter POST — models array [anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL]. Generates a personalized 3-paragraph email asking for a Google review AND a written website testimonial. max_tokens: 500, temperature: 0.7.

Module 6: Resend HTTP POST — client testimonial request email. FROM env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (never brian@cwiai.net). TO contactEmail. Subject: 'Your 30-day milestone — could we ask a quick favour?'. Body: Claude-generated email + Google Review button (env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK) + written testimonial reply-to CTA.

Module 7: HubSpot POST /crm/v3/objects/notes. Logs 'Testimonial request sent' note on the contact (associationTypeId 202). Records send timestamp ET, from address, Google review link, and both ask types.

Module 8: Resend HTTP POST — internal success alert. FROM and TO env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Styled table: client name, email, deal ID, onboarding date, send timestamp ET, HubSpot contact ID, Google review link.

Error Handler (module 9): Fires on any failure in modules 3-8. Resend alert FROM and TO env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Includes error message, failed module, scenario run ID, client details, and ET timestamp for manual remediation. handleErrors: false.

hubspot.label: HubSpot CWI Private App
hubspot.note: HubSpot Private App access token stored in env.HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN. Required scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.notes.write.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter HTTP connection
openrouter.note: No native Make.com module — uses http:ActionSendData. Authenticated via 'Authorization: Bearer {{env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY}}'. Uses 'models' array for automatic fallback: [anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL]. max_tokens: 500, temperature: 0.7.

resend.label: Resend HTTP connection
resend.note: No native Make.com module — uses http:ActionSendData. Authenticated via 'Authorization: Bearer {{env.RESEND_API_KEY}}'. Client-facing email uses env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (verified sending domain, never brian@cwiai.net). Internal alerts and error emails use env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.

webhooks.name: HubSpot Deal — client_onboarding_date Set
webhooks.note: Create a HubSpot deal-based Workflow enrolled when the deal property 'client_onboarding_date' has a known value (is set). Add a 'Send a webhook' action (POST) to the Make.com webhook URL with body: { "dealId": {{deal.hs_object_id}}, "contactEmail": {{deal.associations.contact.email}}, "contactFirstName": {{deal.associations.contact.firstname}}, "contactLastName": {{deal.associations.contact.lastname}}, "onboardingDate": {{deal.client_onboarding_date}} }. Hook ID 3020 must match the ID assigned in Make.

HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN.description: HubSpot Private App access token. Required scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.notes.write.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key. Get from https://openrouter.ai/keys.

OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Fallback model slug for OpenRouter in case anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 is unavailable (e.g. openai/gpt-4o or anthropic/claude-3-5-haiku).

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key. Get from https://resend.com/api-keys.

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Verified client-facing sending address in Resend. Must NOT be brian@cwiai.net. Used as the FROM address on all client-facing testimonial request emails.

CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Internal CWI verified sender in Resend used for internal success alerts and error notifications. Also used as the TO address for internal alerts.

GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK.description: Full Google Business review URL for the client. Included as a CTA button and plain-text link in the testimonial request email.

CLIENT_NAME.description: White-labeled business display name passed to the Claude prompt (e.g. 'Acme Plumbing'). Never use 'CWI AI' here unless this is an internal scenario.

setupInstructions.step1_hubspot_webhook: Create a HubSpot deal-based Workflow that enrolls deals when the property 'client_onboarding_date' is known / becomes set. Add a 'Send a webhook' action (POST) to the Make.com webhook URL (hook 3020) with body fields: dealId, contactEmail, contactFirstName, contactLastName, onboardingDate. Use HubSpot deal tokens to populate these values.
setupInstructions.step2_hubspot_scopes: Create a HubSpot Private App (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Create) with scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read and crm.objects.notes.write. Store the token in env.HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN.
setupInstructions.step3_openrouter: Set env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY from https://openrouter.ai/keys. Confirm anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 is enabled on your OpenRouter account. Set env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL to a secondary model slug (e.g. openai/gpt-4o) — OpenRouter uses the 'models' array to automatically fall back if the primary model is unavailable or over capacity.
setupInstructions.step4_resend: Set env.RESEND_API_KEY. Verify the sender domain for env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS in Resend (Domains > Add domain > add DNS records). This must be a client-appropriate domain — never brian@cwiai.net. Verify env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS as a separate CWI internal sender in Resend.
setupInstructions.step5_env_variables: Set env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK to the client's full Google Business review URL. Set env.CLIENT_NAME to the white-labeled business name used in the Claude prompt.
setupInstructions.step6_sleep_duration: builtin:Sleep is set to 2592000 seconds (exactly 30 days). Make.com Enterprise and higher plans support long-running pauses; confirm your plan accommodates waits exceeding 24 hours before enabling this scenario in production.
setupInstructions.step7_active_check: Module 3 performs a HubSpot contact search by email (1.body.contactEmail) after the 30-day sleep. Module 4 filters on hs_lead_status == 'Client Active'. Clients who have churned, paused, or changed status in the 30-day window will be silently skipped — no error is raised and no email is sent.
setupInstructions.step8_testing: Full test flow: POST a test webhook payload { dealId, contactEmail, contactFirstName, contactLastName, onboardingDate } to hook 3020. Confirm: (1) sleep fires after 2592000 s (or shorten for testing), (2) HubSpot contact is found and is 'Client Active', (3) OpenRouter returns a 3-paragraph email body, (4) Resend delivers from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (not brian@cwiai.net), (5) email body includes both Google review CTA and written testimonial CTA, (6) HubSpot note appears on the contact, (7) internal success alert arrives at env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Test the error handler by temporarily setting an invalid OPENROUTER_API_KEY and verifying the error email fires.
